ties.basis: 025-1b-LE-005.krn lines 1012/1022: source tie continues in another encoded voice of the same staff; LilyPond cannot tie across voices, so the note is held, not reattacked.

bars.description: Pickup (bar 0, one quarter) and bars 1-138 once in written order: Vivace in E minor (1-44), Più lento in E major after the double bar (45-97), and the returning Tempo I with coda (98-138). The source has no repeat signs; nothing is cut or repeated.

endpoints.basis: WITHHELD (19 Oct 2026, ScoreChopin2): the dry run passed the numeric gates (median 0.1309 s) only after four disclosed bar-42-45 constraints, but the final path is still a straight line over 142-150 s and 173-188 s (bars 98-103 and 118-127) with score attacks in the 176.3-177.5 s silence; the bar-137/138 grace and closing-flourish placement is not established. Not refined further in this round; not published.

Conversion: tools/align/humdrum_convert.py reads the unchanged **kern tokens (Humdrum line timing, spine splits/merges, explicit sounding pitches, ties, graces, tuplets) and writes plain MusicXML for the pinned LilyPond 2.24.4 converter. Dynamics, hairpins, pedalling, fingering, stems, layout comments, *rscale display scaling, cue size and editorial text are not converted; slurs are kept only when both ends lie in one encoded voice. Voices are the encoded Humdrum sub-spines on each staff (MusicXML voices 1-4 upper, 5-8 lower), labelled here only as upper/lower staff.
Recording: Edward Neeman (content/listen module; no date given).

anchors.label: bar-42-A-sharp2-E7
anchors.basis: MEAS: the bar-42 accented A-sharp2/E7 after its grace chord (q124). MEAS band energies (dB re the 95th-percentile total, cached pitch features): E7 (MIDI 100) rises to -12 dB at 41.0-41.25 s and A-sharp2 (46) to -10 dB at 41.25-41.5 s; B1/B6 (35/95) rise at 43.75-44.0 s and again at 47.5-47.75 s, each preceded by its grace chord (B4/B5 rises at 43.75 and 46.75 s); E3/B3 (52/59) of the Più lento rise at 52.45-52.55 s after near-silence (below -40 dB) from 51.4 s. The unconstrained pass mapped these bars as a straight line (bar 41 at 46.70 s, bar 45 at 53.01 s), about 5 s late at bar 42.
